article.title: Are the UK sanctions on Israel real progress, or more illusion?
article.author: Mitchell Plitnick
article.content: The UK's new sanctions on Israeli settlements may be groundbreaking, but they're also full of loopholes. F-35 parts are exempt, the state itself is untouched, and enforcement won't start for months. Real progress, but far from enough.
